ATTESTATION OF COMPLIANCE

Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

This document serves as the Attestation of Compliance for the service provider
named below, confirming the results of the annual on-site assessment conducted
by a Qualified Security Assessor.

The assessed entity has demonstrated compliance with the applicable Payment Card
Industry Data Security Standard requirements for the protection of cardholder
data across its in-scope environment.

Assessment completed: September 10, 2026
This Attestation of Compliance is valid through September 9, 2027.
